content: Ɗyemnaa fen mo, kaaɗi wun a nyemcínzeen nɗǝǝn Daa fun Jesu Kristi sǝ, ɗe wu a ɗǝǝɗes met jir, ɓe taji wu bakyit ngurum mo kas.
Katɗang mee gwar jì ɗel nɗǝǝn kuur fuu kǝ kawan mǝ zinariya nkaa nǝkongsar fǝr, kǝ nlǝr ɗeret mo, ɗang kat mee ngujeel jì ɗel nɗǝǝn kuur fuu, kǝ goklee.
Katɗang wu tap wu kaat gwar ɗe wu loplee ɗeret sí, kǝ wu sat nwur nǝ, a jì a tong a peetong ɗeret sǝ, ɗang ɓe wu sat ngujeel nǝ nǝnee, waa ɗar sǝ, koo wu sat nwur nǝ, a tong nyil mpesi nder shii fen.
Katɗang wuu cìn mbii kaa mǝnǝ sǝ, ɓe wu cìn a shikbish. Wuu baakyit ngurum mo nnaar fuu, ɓe wu ɗee a nentokɗyeel mo, shi pan ɗebish mo.

Ɗyemnaa mo, ɗe wen nwal nwun, wu lekom, Naan wur bǝlǝp a nenjeel mo nɗǝǝn yil ɗese, mbǝkǝ mo shinzeen ɗe nDaa Jesu Kristi, kǝ mbǝkǝ mo kat mulki/ɗehai ɗe gyet Naan wu kǝ ten sat nnǝ, wuɗin ncin nenyil ɗe mo nwal nwuɗi mo.
Ɗangɓe wun, wu bakseen nenjeel nǝ mo. A nenlong moo seen a wun, ɗangɓe mo dul wun dǝm kǝ nǝ nluɗiyeel.
Kǝ, a nenlong nǝ moo satpwoo ɗebish nkaa sim ɗeret, ɗe Naan wur le kǝ mo pet wun ɗishik, kaa nen fǝr mo sǝ zak.
Katɗang wu fes wu gam wàar, ɗe nǝ put a pee Naan ɗe azeen-nzeen, ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nǝ nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan nǝnee: <<<<A nwal ngǝnang fwaa kaa sak fwaa sǝ.>> <<Ɓe wu cìn a mbii ɗeret hakyeng.
Ɗangɓe katɗang wuu shin ɗǝǝɗes ngurum mo, a shi baakyit, ɓe mon nkat wun a ɗebish, mɓeɗi wu tep wàar Naan.
Koo ɗang ɗe gurum gam wàar Naan nǝ mo jir, ɗang ɓe wu taa kat nɗǝǝn memee mǝndong ɓejee ɗak, ɓe wu kǝ ɗee a ɗiipǝpal ntom Naan mɓut kor wàar nǝ mo jir.

Ngwar ɗe wu sat nǝ: <<<<Taji wu chìn ngaa kas, <<kǝ <taji wu tukáa kas.> >> Ɗangɓe katɗang mee gwar tukáa, ɓe gwar mǝnǝ kǝ tep wàar Naan nǝ mmǝnǝ, koo ɗe baa wu chìn ngaa kas, ɓe nǝ ɗee nǝ, gwar mǝnǝ taa pal nɗǝǝn mbii ɗe Naan kǝ ten sat nnǝ taji wu cìn kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe nghan kǝn sat nwun nǝ, nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir, ɗe wuu sat, kǝ ɗe wuu cìn, ɓe taji wu muunshik nǝ, a Naan wun ntokɗyeel mmun shi wàar fǝr, ɗe nǝ chínpee mmun, kǝ mǝ ɗee ɗe a mukáa fun mo.
Katɗang mee gurum chii naajeel niyee mo, ɓe Naan wu nchii naajeel ngwar mǝni, parɗi Naan wu ntokɗyeel ngwar mǝnǝ zak. Ɗangɓe naajeel kǝ Naan nǝ se koorong nkaa ɗiyeel.

Ɗyemnaa mo, katɗang mee gurum sat nǝnee, wuɗi shinzeen nNaan, ɗang ɓe, baa wur chìn ɗak ɗe Naan sat nnǝ mǝ chìn mo kas, ɓe baa shinzeen mǝnǝ kǝ mee kwoop nǝ kas. Chinarang ɗangɓe shinzeen mǝnǝn mɓam wu ye?
Katɗang ɓe, mee ɗyemnǝǝn ɗemish koo ɗe mat, baa mo kǝ leelop, koo mbiise kas.
Ɗangɓe wu sat nwur nǝ, <<A seet ryang, Naan le kǝ a kat mbiise kǝ leelep mo zak.>> Ɗangɓe baa wu shin leelep, koo mbiise nwur kas, ɓe kwoop mǝnǝ a meye?
Ni aasǝ zak, kǝ shinzeen ɗe baa nǝ ashak kǝ ɗak kas, ɓe nǝ a ɗiimumuut.

Ɗangɓe mee gurum mmak sat nǝnee, <<Mee gwar kǝ shinzeen, kǝ memee kǝ chìn ɗak ɗeret mo,>> Wen nlap gwar mǝnǝ a nǝnee, <<A kám shinzeen kǝ mee gurum nghan, ɗe baa nǝ ashak kǝ ɗak kas ɗe! Ɓe wen nkám shinzeen fen ngha, shi ɗak fen mo.>>
Waa shinzeen nǝ, Naan ɗe azeen, wu a mǝndong, kaaɗi a sat aasǝ, ɓe nǝ ret. Ɗangɓe koo a riin ɗebish mo, ɓe mo shinzeen nǝ, Naan wu a mǝndong, ɗangɓe kǝǝrmuut kǝ yaa mo, kǝ moo ɗaar zak.
Waa mwen, baa a man nǝ, katɗang gurum shinzeen nNaan, ɗangɓe baa gwar mǝnǝ kǝ chìn ɗak ɗeret kas, ɓe shinzeen fǝr nǝ ɗee a buu mmǝnǝ kas aa?
A yee puun fun Abraham, gyet a me le ɗangɓe Naan naa Abraham kaa gwar ɗe ɗeret sǝ ye? A mɓe ɗe gyet wu mang làa fǝr Aizik, mbǝkǝ wu shin mbiizuum ɗe nNaan, kaaɗi gyet Naan kǝ ten sat nnǝ wu chìn sǝ.
Ni agaak nǝ, gyet nɗǝǝn tong Abraham, ɓe shinzeen, kǝ chìn mbii ɗeret mo, moo set a ndangshak. Mbii ɗe gyet wu chìn ni, nǝ gam shinzeen nwur.
Ni gam mbii ɗe gyet mo kǝ ten ran nǝ nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan sǝ nǝnee: <<<<Abraham wu shinzeen nNaan, mpeemǝnǝ ɓe <<Abraham wu ɗee a gwar ɗe ɗeret nyit <<Naan.>> ɗang gyet gurum moo pet wu a shaar Naan.
Yaksi ɓe gha naa agaak nǝnee, a nɗǝǝn ɗak ɗeret ɗe gurum kǝ cìn, ɗangɓe gurum kǝ mak ɗee a ɗeret nyit Naan, baa a shinzeen nNaan ɓejee ɗak kas.
Ni aasǝ zak Rahab, mat ngaa sǝ, gyet waa lap nyemcoghol mo, kǝzak, gyet waa tap bwet mo a mee ar ɗiiɗik. Baa gyet a mɓe ɗak ɗeret ɗese, ɗangɓe waa ɗee a ɗeret nyit kǝ Naan kas aa?
Ni aasǝ zak, kat baa riin kuɗi nɗǝǝn gurum kas, ɓe gwar mǝnǝ ɗee a kúm nǝ. Aasǝ, shinzeen nɗin nchìn ɗak ɗeret mo, ɓe nǝ a ɗiimumuut zak.
